analysis.headline: Shares Your Data for Marketing
analysis.quote: We may share personal information with third parties, such as advertising technology partners, data analytics providers and social networks engaged by IBM to deliver targeted IBM advertisements on their platforms, to aggregate information for analysis, and to track engagement with those advertisements.

analysis.headline: Shares with Business Partners
analysis.quote: Our business model includes cooperation with independent Business Partners for marketing, selling, and the provision of IBM products and services. Where appropriate (for example, when necessary for the fulfilment of an order), we share business contact information with selected Business Partners.

analysis.headline: Trains AI on Your Data
analysis.quote: IBM’s AI models and systems are designed, trained, validated, and tested on data from publicly available sources that may incidentally contain Personal Information.

analysis.headline: Employer Controls Your Account
analysis.quote: If your account is created by using an email address containing a domain owned by an organization which you are employed by, contracted to, or volunteer for, your organization can: inquire about the status of your account, request your account settings (including your personal information), and, at its option, convert it to an enterprise ID.

analysis.headline: Records Your Support Calls
analysis.quote: The information that we collect may include any information exchanged during our phone conversations or provided during Live Chat support sessions on our websites. This may include a recording or transcript of your conversations with us.

analysis.headline: Tracks You Across Sites
analysis.quote: All of these technologies may be used to provide connected features across our websites or display targeted IBM advertising (subject to your cookie preferences) on other websites based on your interests.

analysis.headline: Cameras Monitor IBM Locations
analysis.quote: Camera supervision and access management are used for reasons of security and safety of our locations, employees, and assets.

analysis.headline: Collects Public Recruitment Data
analysis.quote: Regarding recruitment, we may look for prospective candidates with the help of recruitment intermediaries and may use publicly available information on social media platforms to identify prospective candidates for a specific function.

analysis.headline: Retains Data for Years
analysis.quote: The data relevant to your DR request is retained for a minimum of three years from the date of your last DR-related communication with IBM, to address any request you may have in relation to it, and for IBM's compliance and recording purposes.
